newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil C-bank seeks Bamerindus head - paper.
newsitem.headline: Brazil C-bank seeks Bamerindus head - paper.

text.p: Brazil's Central Bank is looking for a new manager to handle the finances of private bank Bamerindus and sell it by December 1997, a local newspaper said.
Gazeta Mercantil said that if the sale of Bamerindus resulted in profits, they should be distributed between the bank's shareholders, it added.
"Today there are a few investors interested in buying Bamerindus," an unnamed Central Bank official taking part in negotiations about the bank's future was quoted as saying.
The Central Bank will facilitate the change in the bank's ownership by granting funds from the government's PROER program to encourage bank mergers and acquisitions," the newspaper said.
Bamerindus, Brazil's fourth largest private bank, has been the subject of speculation for months that the bank would be sold.
Earlier this year the bank announced a reorganisation of assets but market analysts expected more changes.
